(587)'od gsal snying gi thig le las/sgrol ma nyer gcig sgrub thabs bzhugs so/(588)'od gsal snying gi thig le las/gtso mo 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs kya

tei:div.tei:p: (587)'od gsal snying gi thig le las/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ (588)

'od gsal snying gi thig le las/ gtso mo 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs kyi/ lha mang mngon rtogs bsgom pa ni/ sbyor rjes khog dbug ji bzhin las/ dngos gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa la/ stong srog gnad nas zin pa na/ gang gong ltar gsal kyang khyad med yang*/ mos pas dbang gi bye brag las/ nang gi dbye ba bstan par bya/ dngos gzhi'i chos kyi de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ/ sems nyid rang bzhin skye ba med/ rnam par mi rtog rtog las 'das/ chos (589)rnams mnyam pa chen po'i dbyings/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom/ oṃ dharmā dhartu bi shuddhe hūm̐/ snying rje sgyu ma ni/ āḥ skye ba rnam bzhis bsdus pa yi/ ma rtogs log pa'i sems can rnams/ rang snang 'khrul bas rang bcing ba/ sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ti āḥ rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin ni/ (590)hūm̐/ skye med ngang las snying rje'i gdangs/ 'gags med cir yang 'char ba las/ rang byung rig pa yi ge tām̐/ g.yu zhun lugs su blugs pa ltar/ sra zhing 'thas la mi shig pa/ mi phyed rdo rje'i chos bdun bsgom/ dzñā na badzra tsitta sa ma ti āḥ de las dbyings kyi yi ge lnga/ mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin/ 'phros pas snod bcud zhen rtog sbyang*/ yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag oṃ āeḥ.am̐ lam̐ sam̐ ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ dharmā dhartu manta (591)pañtsa kṣa bu thā na na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal bi shuddhe saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ bhrūm̐ las 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ sprul pa'i zhing khams po ta la/ sna tshogs nor bu'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs/ 'dod rnams pha gu rin chen phreng*/ 'da' yab shar bu mjes pa'i tog sgo rgyan rgyu 'bras rta bab ldan/ drwa ba drwa phyed 'phyang 'phrul dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan brgyan/ 'dod yon mchod sprin bsam mi khyab/ nang khyams (592)gru chad glo 'bur bcas/ lte bar padma 'dab ma bzhi/

khyams sgor phyogs bzhir pad zla re/ sam̐ padma maṇḍal/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ rang bzhin rtsa ba'i yi ge tām̐/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bab/ g.yu zhun lta bu'i tām̐ḥyig las/ utpal tām̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ srid pa dag ni thams cad du/ sna tshogs 'od dang zer gyis khengs/ sprul pa sgyu ma 'ja' tshon dang*/ smig rgyu chu zla gzugs brnyan bzhin/ 'jig rten bdun po snang byas nas/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos so (593)cog ye na dag mnyam chen po'i ngang*/ snod bcud lha yi rol par shar/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ las kyi rigs las skyes pa yi/ brtson 'grus shugs dang ldan pa'i yum/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs ma/ ljang gsal g.yu bkrag kha dog la/ ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa ltar/ dag cing gtsang la dri ma med/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab/ zhi zhing 'jum pa'i mdangs dang ldan/ thugs rjes rjes su chags pa yis/ smin legs spyan (594)ni rnam par 'khyugs/ ka sha'i ras kyi stod g.yog dang*/ pañtsa'i gos kyi smad dkris shing*/ rin chen thor gtsug do shal dang*/ rna cha gdub skor 'og pags dang*/ sna tshogs rgyan gyis mjes par spras/ 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa 'chang*/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ g.yon pas dkon mchog gsum mtshon rgyas/ sdong bu dang bcas utpal la/ gser gyi 'khor los mtshan pa g.yon/ zhabs gnyis rta babs skyil krung gis/ padma rgyal pa'i ze'u (595)'bru'i steng*/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od kyi tshogs/ sku las 'phros pa de nyid las/ utpal sngon po ge sar bcas/ bdud rtsi'i zeg ma 'phro ba'i steng*/ 'byung po'i stobs rnams zil gnon cing*/ 'jigs pa mtha' dag 'joms mjad pa'i/ rnam 'phrul lha mo nyi shu dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dpag med gsal/ shar gyi padma'i 'dabs steng du/ sgrol ma sngo sangs nam mkha'i mdog g.yas pas tri shul thugs kar 'jin/ (596)g.yon pas utpal sngon po bsnams/

sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ mthong bas yid 'phrog tā re ma/ padma rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru la/ zla ba rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ lho phyogs 'dabs ma ser po'i steng*/ sgrol ma gser gyi kha dog can/ g.yas pas ral gri thugs kar 'jin/ g.yon pas utpal ser po bsnams/ tshogs gnyis rgyas byed tā re ma/ padma rgyas pa las byung ba'i/ zla ba rgyas pa'i (597)gdan gyi steng*/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ nub phyogs 'dab ma dmar po'i steng*/ sgrol ma 'jig rten dbang byed ma/ bhantu ji wa ka yi mdog g.yas pas 'khor lo thugs kar 'jin/ g.yon pas utpal dmar po bsnams/ padma rgyas pa las byung zhing*/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan gyi steng*/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ byang phyogs 'dab ma ljang gu'i steng*/ sgrol ma sna tshogs las byed ma/ mar gad dri ma med (598)pa'i mdog g.yas pas gdugs dkar thugs kar 'jin/ g.yon pas utpal ljang gu bsnams/ padma rgyas pa las byung ba'i/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ de ltar rigs lnga rigs kyi gtso mo rnams gsal ba'i phyi rol du sprul pa'i lha mo rigs bsdus te ched du gsal ba ni/ oṃ tā re tuttā re swā hā/ tām̐ḥ phyogs mtshams sa bon tām̐ bcas pa/ tshon chen lnga yi kha dog gyis/ 'od zer chen pos snang ba ni/ sprul pa ye shes sgyu ma las/ 'jig rten bdun po gang byas nas/ snod bcud (599)rgyud rnams dag byas te/ kun kyang lha yi rol par shar/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rigs kyi lha mo lnga/ dkyil 'khor khyams kyi shar phyogs su/ padma zla ba brtsegs pa'i steng*/ myur ma dpal mo grags chen ma/ dmar gsal khro 'jum chags pa'i nyams/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyinaphyag rgya mjad/ g.yas 'khyil dung mtshan utpal g.yon/ mkhyen gnyis mchog sbyinadabyangs can ma/ nya gang zla ba brtsegs pa'i zhal (600)g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/

me long hrīs mtshan utpal g.yon/ bsod nams ye shes stobs spel ma/ snger sngo bsod nams mchog ster ser/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ rin chen mtshan pa'i uutpal g.yon/ tshe dang ye shes dbang byed ma/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gser mdog can/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal la gnas tshe bum g.yon/ 'jig rten gsum rnams dbang mjad ma/ ku ru kulle (601)le brgan mdog phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar brten mda' gzhu g.yon/ oṃ tā re tutta re swā hā/ tām̐/ phyag mtshan uutapal tām̐ bcas pa/ tshon chen lnga yi kha dog gyis/ 'od zer chen po'i snang ba ni/ dbang po'i gzhu dang smig rgyu bzhin/ 'jig rten bdun po gang byas nas/ snod bcud rgyud rnams dag byas te/ kun kyang lha yi rol par shar/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen rigs kyi lha mo lnga/ dkyil 'khor (602)khyams kyi lho phyogs su/ padma zla ba brtsegs pa'i gdan/ 'byung po kun gyi stobs gzhom ma/ 'jigs byed dmar nag khros pa'i nyams/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas phur pa g.yon/ pha rol sde dang stobs 'joms ma/ gtum mo mi thub khro gnyer nag g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phya rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas ral gri g.yon/ bdud dang dgra bo gsod byed ma/ gzhan mi rgyal ba ma gad mdog g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag (603)rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas rdo rje g.yon/ bzhad pa brgyad ldan dbang byed ma/ khams gsum rnam rgyal dmar nag nyams/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas rgyal mtshan g.yon/ thams cad 'gugs pa'i dbang phyug ma/ nor ster dmar ser zhi ma khro/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas gter bum g.yon/ oṃ tā re tuttā re swā hā/ tām̐/ sa bon phyag mtshan tām̐ bcas pa/ tshon chen lang yi kha dog kyi/ (604)'od zer chen po'i snang ba ni/

chu zla gzugs brnyan cho 'phrul gyis/ 'jig rten bdun po gang byas te/ snod bcud rgyud rnams dag byas nas/ kun kyang lha yi rol par shar/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ padma rigs kyi lha mo lnga/ dkyil 'khor khyams kyi nub phyogs su/ padma zla ba brtsegs pa'i steng*/ srid zhi'i bde legs dpal bskyed ma/ bkra shis don byed lha mo ser/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas dpal be'u g.yon/ gnod gdug ma (605)lus tshar gcod ma/ dgra dpung 'joms dmar spyan gsum ldan/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas rdo rje gdeng*/ dam 'gong sde brgyad brlag mjad ma/ khro gnyer can ma mun pa'i mdog g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas gtun shing g.yon/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal zhi mjad ma/ rab tu zhi ba pad dkar mdog g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas spyi blugs g.yon/ byad gdon nus (606)'phrog stobs gzhom ma/ 'bar ba'i 'od can dmar la dwangs/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas rgya gram g.yon/ oṃ tā re tuttā re swā hā/ tām̐/ phyag mtshan sa bon tām̐ bcas pa/ tshon chen lnga yi kha dog kyis/ 'od zer chen po'i snang ba ni/ rten 'brel sgyu ma'i rol pa yis/ 'jig rten bdun po snang byas te/ snod bcud rgyud rnams rnam par dag kun kyang lha yi rol par shar/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ las kyi rigs kyi lha mo lnga/ (607)dkyil 'khor khyams kyi byang phyogs su/ padma zla ba brtsegs pa'i gdan/ 'jigs pa'i tshogs chen 'jigs mjad ma/ dpag med gnon ma gur gum mdog g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas mchod rten g.yon/ brtan g.yo'i dug rnams zhi mjad ma/ rma bya chen po dkar gsal zhal/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas zla ba g.yon/ snod bcud rten 'brel nyes sel ma/

mi pham rgyal mo (608)chu shel mdog g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas gdugs dkar g.yon/ tsha grang rims nas zhi mjad ma/ ri khrod lha mo dmar ser mdog g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas za ma tog blo bzang nyams gso bkrag mdangs bskyed/ 'od zer can ma dkar dmar zhal/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ utpal lar gnas gser nya g.yon/ kun kyang rta babs skyil krung bzhugs/ nyi gzhon 'char ka'i (609)lang tsho can/ mtshan dpe 'od kyi pung po 'bar/ sems can don la brtson shugs ldan/ bud med sgyu ma'i snyems 'chang zhing*/ thugs rje chags pas sapayan 'khyugs cing*/ ma rnams ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes/ dbugs 'byin chen po sbyin par mjad/ dkyil 'khor phyogs kyi sgo bzhi ru/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs ka nas/ sa bon tām̐ re tu re bzhi/ 'jig rten gsum du spros byas pas/ sa chen rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od (610)kyis gang*/ lha dang lha min nam mkha' lding*/ mi'am ci dang dri za'i tshogs/ lto 'phye srin po 'byung po rnams/ tshar bcad stobs 'phrog spa skong nas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor sgrol ma lcags kyu dkar/ phyag gnyis thugs kar lcags kyu 'jin/ lho sgor sgrol ma zhags pa ser/ phyag gnyis thugs kar zhags pa 'jin/ nub sgor sgrol ma lcags sgrogs dmar/ phyag gnyis thugs kar lcags sgrogs 'jin/ byang sgor sgrol ma dril bu ljang*/ phyag (611)gnyis thugs kar dril bu 'jin/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo bzhin/ kun kyang drang srong khros pa'i nyams/ spyan zlum mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ dmar ser ral pa gyen du phyogs/ zhabs gnyis rta bab skyil krung gis/ padma rgyas pa las byung ba'i/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ lha rnams spyi mgrin thugs ka ru/ rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ 'bru gsum ye shes srog dang bcas/ ye shes lnga bdag cod paṇa 'chang*/

gsal stong lhun grub chen (612)por bsgom/ phyi rol zhing gi bkod pa ni/ padma drwa ba can gyi zhing*/ sna tshogs khams kyis rnam par spras/ sgrib pa mi mnga' mngon sum du/ rin chen lnga yi rab mjes pa/ yan lag brgyad ldan byugs pa yi/ mtsho dang mtsho phran rdzogs bu'i tshogs/ nor bu sna tshogs bye bas gtams/ mjes pa'i me tog kun nas bskor/ dga' zhing 'phyo la lding ba'i bya/ snyan pa'i skad 'byin chos sgra sgrogs/ rin chen gling na lhun po dang*/ dag pa'i zhing na dag pa'i rdzas/ pi waṃ gling bu rdza (613)lnga dang*/ sil snyan glu gar bstod dbyangs kyis/ lha dang lha mo bsam mi khyab/ tā la dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal/ dar dang rin chen 'phyang 'phrul dang*/ me tog 'bras bu rnam par smin/ phyogs bzhir dar gyi ba dan las/ spos kyi dri zhim rgyas par 'gengs/ nam mkhar ratna sna tshogs pa'i/ sprin tshogs stug po las skyes pa'i/ spos chu me tog 'dres pa dang*/ 'dod yon sna tshogs char chen 'bebs/ gser gyi brag skyibs brag ri'i khrod/ (614)spang dang me tog brgyan pa'i tshal/ smin pa'i glang chen stong dag dang*/ rta mchog yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ri dwags tshogs ni dal gyis rgyu/ grub pa'i rig 'jin bye ba brgya/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po dang*/ rigs sngags rgyal mo stong phrag gis/ rtag tu zhi ba brten pa'i gnas/ snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gsal/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang tām̐ yig ljang gu las (615) 'od zer ljang gu lcags kyu'i dbyibs can phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad dang 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyi thugs dam bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par bzhengs nas dam tshig pa rnams la sib kyis thim par dmigs nas/ oṃ/ skyob pa 'od dpag med pa yis/

thugs dam chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ smon lam stobs las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ sgrol ma'i mtshan gyi rnga chen po/ zhing rnams kun tu rab grags ma/ rje btsun sgrol ma (616)'khor dang bcas/ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'byon par 'tshal/ nyon mongs dri ma bsal ba dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sel byed cing*/ sems can rnams la sman slad du/ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra e hya he ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ bzhugs su gsol bani/ oṃ/ nyi ma zla ba rgyas 'dra ba'i/ gzhon nu'i sku la 'gying bag can/ sangs rgyas thams cad (617)bskyed pa'i yum/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ utpal sngon po'i ge sar la/ nya gang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi thugs ldan pas/ gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol/ padma tsaṇḍa sa ma yā tiṣṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ las dang nyon mongs stobs rnams dang*/ bdud kyi sde rnams pham mjad ma/ skyob pa skyabs 'os bde ba sbyin/ shes bcu rnam dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ dbyangs can lha mo spyan yangs ma/ shes rab blo (618)'phel snyan pa che/ g.yul las sgrol byed rgyal ba mo/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ a tī pū ho/ pra ti ja ho/

de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ me tog sil ma phreng ba spel/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re puṣpe pū ja me gha sa mu tra (619)spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ sman shing rang byung sbyar ba'i spos/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ la dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re dhuppe pū ja me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byabs na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin (620)rlabs shing*/ snang gsalal sgron ma'i bye brag gis/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re a lo ke pū ja me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ tsandan ga bur sbyar ba'i dri/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang (621)bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re ghandhe pū ja me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ bza' btung ro brgya ldan pa yi/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ/ (622)sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re nai wi te pū je me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ glu dang rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re shabta pū ja me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ gzhan yang mchod pa 'os pa'i rgyan/ (623)gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*/ sna tshogs gos kyi bye brag dang*/ dpag bsam rin chen ljon pa'i shing*/ dri zhim me tog 'bras bur ldan/ rgyal srid bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad/ lha dang mi yi 'jig rten na/ bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i/ 'bab chu klu dang ldeng ka dang*/ mtsho dang rdzing bu khrus kyi rdzing*/ padma utpal drwa bas kheb/ ngang pa bzhad sogs lding ba'i brgyan/ rin chen khang mjes drwa ba dang*/ dra phyed nyi zla'i snang ba can/ mchod (624)pa'i lha mo mang po bcas/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā re ma hā pū ja me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ gzugs kyi lha mo rdo rje ma/ me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ gzugs mjes gar gyi bye brag gis/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char (625)chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ru pa pra titstsha pū ja ho/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ sgra yi lha mo pi wang ma/ mnyam nyid/ ye shes ngo bo nyid/ sgra snyan bstod pa'i bye brag gis/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/

(626)las dang ye shes dngos rub stsol/ oṃ shabta pra titstsha pū ja ho/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ dri yi lha mo zhal bsil thogs/ sor rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ghandhe pra titstsha pū ja ho/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams (627)kyi byin rlabs shing*/ ro yi lha mo zhal zas thogs/ bya grab ye shes ngo bo nyid/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ rā sa pra titstsha pū ja ho/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ reg bya'i lha mo gos zung thogs/ chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi (628)char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ aṃ sparshe pra titstsha pū ja ho/ sman gtor rakta'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ 'chi med bdud rtsi ra pa yan/ nyon mongs chags pa'i rakta dang*/ blang dor gnyis med ba ling ta/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa bzhes/ oṃ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta rakta bha ling ta pū ja ho/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med la/ mchod bya mchod byed ka (629)nas dag rang byung ye shes chen po'i ngang*/ mnyam rdzogs chen po'i mchod pa bzhes/ dharmā dhartu dzñā na badzra sa ma ya ho/ de nas bstod pa ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta samyaksaṃ bhuddha ya te tre ya te tu re oṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag 'jigs pa brgyad rnams zhi bar mjod/ bde gshegs su yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i thugs/ me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo ma/ rdo rje yum (630)la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rdzogs/ mnyam nyid ye shes ngang la gnas/ tshogs chen bsod nams mchog ster ma/ rin chen yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mi shig gsung*/ sor rtog ye shes thams cad mkhyen/ 'jig rten gsum po dbang byed ma/ padma'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rdzogs/ bya grub ye shes chags thogs bral/ sna tshogs phrin las mthar phyin ma/ las kyi yum la (631)phyag 'tshal bstod/ ljang mdzes sprin gyi gur gseb nas/ sangs rgyas ma chags padma'i spyan/ gzhon nu mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus/ khro bo'i tshogs chen spro zhing sdud/ brkyang bskum stabs kyi gdug pa 'dul/ khro gnyer can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje las/ phrin las sna tshogs mjad pa'i gar/ rnam 'phrul sgrol ma nyi shu la/ rnam kun gdung bas khyod la bstod/ (632)oṃ/ 'jig rten gsum na grags pa yi/ 'byung po gang dag ji snyed pas/ zhabs kyi padma la btud cing*/ 'jig rten gsum mgon khyod la bstod/ sems can kun la phan bzhed ma/ dbang phyug lha dang lha min dang*/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ bskur 'os mchod gnas khyed la bstod/ bkra shis rnam rgyal skye dgu'i bdag rgod bag dregs dang dri ma zhi/ padma'i spyan dang zhal mnga' ba/ gsum gtsang gtsang mar gyur la bstod/ utpal sngon po'i zur mig gis/ (633)rtag tu 'gro ba skyong mjad cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras bcas kyis/ sgrol ma'i mtshan gyis bsngags la bstod/ gang zhig mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*/ de yi don kun 'grub gyur zhing*/ nyon mongs kun las rnam grol ba/ sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob par 'gyur/

'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ 'phags ma khyed kyis rjes bzung shig yang dag lam gyi dmigs sto pa/ bdag gi gshegs gnyen mjad du gsol/ de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ āḥ thugs kar (634)padma zla ba'i steng*/ rang byung rig pa yi ge tām̐ḥ de mthar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ 'od 'phros las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub/ ces/ rje btsun ma'i thugs kar utpal dang zla ba'i dal gyi steng rig pa tām̐ḥyig ljang gu'i mthar rtsa ba'i bstod pa rdo rje'i tshig gi phreng ba rnams lu gu rgyud 'od zer sngo dmar gyi thag pas sbrel ma rang sgra dang bcas pa chos skor du 'khor ba dang*/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi ljang gu'i rgyun dang utpal ljang gu'i ze'u 'bru las/ byang chub (635)sems dpa' 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug zhi bar mjad pa mang po nyi zer gyi rdul lata bu 'phros pas/ lha dang*/ lha ma yin/ nam mkha'i lding*/ mi'am ci/ dri za/ lto 'phye/ srin po/ 'byung po'i tshogs gang su yang rung ba rnams kyi stobs dang sde rnams tshar bcad nas 'jigs pa'i tshogs mtha' dag zhi zhing snang la rang bzhin med par sbyangs/ slar 'jig rten gsum po thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku dang gsung sngags kyi sgra dbyangs thugs (636)utpal tām̐ ljang gu'i mtshan pa sha stag tu gyur nas bdag la thim par bsam la/ bstod pa'i rgyal po ci mang du btang*/ de nas/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla ba bsnyen pa'o/ zhi ba rtsa sngags shams/ ku ru sarba pā shaṃ shintaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhi ba chen po rtsa sngags la/ swā shintaṃ ku ru ho/ zhes btags la bzla'o/ las myur du 'grub sngags/ tu tu oṃ tu tu/ tu tu tā tu tu/ tu tu re tu tu/ tu tu tu tu tu/ tu tu tā tu tu/ tu tu re tu tu/ tu tu tu tu tu/ tu tu re tu tu/ zhes 'jam dpal gyi thugs dam sgrol ma'i gzungs/ ag khe (637)pag khe/ na ji ti/ na ga pa te/

na hi li/ ja hi li/ ja hi li/ bha ti/ tsa tri la ba te swā hā/ brgya rtsa bzla'o/ de nas sgrol ma'i rigs sngags de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi sngags/ arte/ marte/ ba ke bā ra ke be ke ṭa/ dra ma ni/ ta ra ma ti/ ṭu ṭa ma ṭi/ ṭu ṭa ma ṭi/ ṭu ṭa ma tiṭa/ ṭu ṭa ṭi pu re/ hi li mu le ti li swā hā/ brgya stong la sogs par bzla'o/ phan yon ni/ gang zhig yid la dran byas na/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun dang*/ 'phags pas rtag tu byin gyis rlabs/ skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ (638) sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba dkyus bzhin no/ de ltar rtsa sgrub kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba 'di/ theg mchog snying po'i rnal 'byor bla ma dpal ldan gyi ngor chos kyi bdag po/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba'o/ maṅga lam/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu bkra shis par gyur cig// /
